alphabet_drills.prompt: Show the sign for letter: A
alphabet_drills.hint: Make a closed fist with your thumb resting upright along the outer side of your index finger.

alphabet_drills.prompt: Show the sign for letter: B
alphabet_drills.hint: Hold all 4 fingers straight up together, with your thumb folded flat across your palm.

alphabet_drills.prompt: Show the sign for letter: C
alphabet_drills.hint: Curve all 4 fingers and your thumb to form the physical curved shape of the letter 'C'.

alphabet_drills.prompt: Show the sign for letter: D
alphabet_drills.hint: Point your index finger straight up, while touching your thumb tip to middle, ring, and pinky tips.

alphabet_drills.prompt: Show the sign for letter: E
alphabet_drills.hint: Curl all your fingertips tightly down towards your palm, with your thumb tucked across underneath.

alphabet_drills.prompt: Show the sign for letter: F
alphabet_drills.hint: Touch your index fingertip and thumb tip into a circle ('OK' sign), while keeping the other 3 fingers straight up.

alphabet_drills.prompt: Show the sign for letter: G
alphabet_drills.hint: Point your index finger and thumb horizontally to the side, parallel to each other like a pinch.

alphabet_drills.prompt: Show the sign for letter: H
alphabet_drills.hint: Extend both your index and middle fingers together horizontally to the side, thumb tucked.

alphabet_drills.prompt: Show the sign for letter: I
alphabet_drills.hint: Make a closed fist and extend only your pinky finger pointing straight up.

alphabet_drills.prompt: Show the sign for letter: K
alphabet_drills.hint: Point your index finger straight up, extend your middle finger forward at a 45-degree angle, with your thumb resting between them.

alphabet_drills.prompt: Show the sign for letter: L
alphabet_drills.hint: Extend your thumb and index finger outward at a 90-degree angle to form an 'L' shape.

alphabet_drills.prompt: Show the sign for letter: M
alphabet_drills.hint: Make a fist and tuck your thumb under your first three fingers (index, middle, ring), so only the thumb tip peeks out.

alphabet_drills.prompt: Show the sign for letter: N
alphabet_drills.hint: Make a fist and tuck your thumb under your first two fingers (index and middle).

alphabet_drills.prompt: Show the sign for letter: O
alphabet_drills.hint: Curve all your fingers down to touch your thumb tip, forming a complete 'O' circle.

alphabet_drills.prompt: Show the sign for letter: P
alphabet_drills.hint: Make the 'K' sign shape, but point your wrist and fingers downwards towards the floor.

alphabet_drills.prompt: Show the sign for letter: Q
alphabet_drills.hint: Make the 'G' sign shape, but point your index finger and thumb downwards towards the floor.

alphabet_drills.prompt: Show the sign for letter: R
alphabet_drills.hint: Cross your middle finger over your index finger (the 'fingers crossed' / good luck sign).

alphabet_drills.prompt: Show the sign for letter: S
alphabet_drills.hint: Make a tight fist with your thumb folded firmly across the front of your other fingers.

alphabet_drills.prompt: Show the sign for letter: T
alphabet_drills.hint: Make a fist and tuck your thumb between your index and middle fingers.

alphabet_drills.prompt: Show the sign for letter: U
alphabet_drills.hint: Extend your index and middle fingers straight up together, touching each other.

alphabet_drills.prompt: Show the sign for letter: V
alphabet_drills.hint: Extend your index and middle fingers in a 'V' / Peace sign shape, spread apart.

alphabet_drills.prompt: Show the sign for letter: W
alphabet_drills.hint: Extend your index, middle, and ring fingers straight up in a 'W' shape, holding your pinky down with your thumb.

alphabet_drills.prompt: Show the sign for letter: X
alphabet_drills.hint: Make a fist and crook your index finger like a small hook.

alphabet_drills.prompt: Show the sign for letter: Y
alphabet_drills.hint: Extend only your thumb and pinky finger out (the 'hang loose' / Shaka sign).
